notes.title: Store issue fixed! And VoidExpanse & Pariahs' Bane Update!
notes.notes:
First of all, we were finally able to fix the store issue that prevented people from purchasing the Pariahs' Bane expansion (there was an error in configuration that made the expansion "free to everyone"). Thankfully Valve team helped us to resolve it reasonable quickly, so now you can grab the expansion! Especially if you have already taken advantage of the situation and completed it without purchasing first ;)

We have also just uploaded a new update for the original game and Pariahs' Bane expansion that addresses a large number of small issues that came up after the launch and made a few improvements.

We hope you guys like the update!

And just in case, here's a link to the expansion page:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/499410/

notes.title: VoidExpanse Update v1.6.12
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7634270/7ac36e24cdc90c10e799c01cf0682c044d473237.png

Greetings, VoidExplorers! Today we have released an update for VoidExpanse, which includes following improvements:

Substantial UI performance increase: all loading is now done faster.
Improved pathfinding in Autopiloting mode. Ships are now less likely to collide with obstacles. 
Option "Pause on minimize" was moved to the pause screen.*
Fixed seldom launching issues on Mac systems.
Fixed seldom launching issues on Linux systems.**
Fixed minor gameplay bugs.
*This was done according to our players' feedback regarding traveling with game minimized. Previously the option was located in the settings tab, but in order to improve the experience we decided to move it. Now you can simply un-check the option right in the pause menu and travel with your game minimized. Of course, this change is only applicable to a Single-player mode, as Multiplayer doesn't have pause.

**Some issues may still remain due to a vast variety of Linux-based OS. Please check this topic in Steam Discussions in case you still have launching issues on Linux.

You can find complete release notes on our forums.

notes.title: VoidExpanse v1.6.10 Update
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/ZHxnGNo.png

Greetings!

We have just released a long awaited update (v1.6.9) for VoidExpanse. Primary goal of this update was to address several issues related to third party software components that are used in the game. This has finally allowed us to fix a number of longstanding issues, especially for Linux users.

Here’s the list of changes:

Improved Linux support. This should fix most of the reported crashes and other compatibility problems. Please let us know on the forums if there are any other issues!
Improved networking.
Fixed "boom" achievement.
Fixed issue with weapons bindings.
And fixed various other issues.


And here is another small update (v1.6.10):

Added quick shortcut: Ctrl+click to start autopilot to the specified location on System or Galaxy map. (for Mac users: Cmd+click also works)
Station storage cargo capacity can be modded now!
Fixed bug where it was impossible to start a new singleplayer game (with local game server)
Fixed dialog window not stretching to fit the message content
Improved handling of server errors (better stability and convenience for modding)

notes.title: Dinocide Greenlight and VoidExpanse 1.6.x update!
notes.notes:
We have a new VoidExpanse update for you! But before that let me share some information about our other project - Dinocide!

https://atomictorch.com/Images/Upload/10316.png

Dinocide is a classic NES inspired old-school single-player platformer in a prehistoric fantasy world. Dinocide tries to capture the drive and fun of this era and recreate it in a modern way!

You can find more information of the official website.

And you can also vote for us in Dinocide Greenlight, in fact we would really appreciate your support as that would allow us to get the game on Steam and proceed forward!

http://atomictorch.com/Images/Upload/10167.jpg?maxwidth=520

Anyway, back to VoidExpanse!

This update took us a bit more time than we initially anticipated, but it is an extremely important update in the long run. We completely rewrote certain libraries and addressed many longstanding issues. This should really be the most stable build thus far and we hope that this will solve all known issues once and for all, giving you guys the best possible user experience!

Aside from bugfixes we were also able to sneak-in a few gameplay changes and balance adjustments and a few new features for modders, so that should be useful as well!

Anyway, you can read the detailed patch notes on our forums, as always.

notes.title: Update v1.5 is here!
notes.notes:
http://atomictorch.com/Images/Upload/10167.jpg?maxwidth=520

Our next update is finally ready and released to Steam! But what's new this time? Let's take a look at some of the interesting additions and changes with this update!

New weapons - We've introduced a few new and interesting weapons. This time we added new mechanics along with it as well. You can find mine deploying missile or auto-swivel cannons, but most fun of all is the solar blaster!

http://atomictorch.com/Images/Upload/10297.png?maxwidth=520

Updated map system - Not only does it look better but map generation is improved as well.

http://atomictorch.com/Images/Upload/10295.png?maxwidth=520

Improved AI - Remember how pirates used to ram your ship in the past? That will happen no more! But aside from that their AI has been improved overall making all enemies you encounter in VoidExpanse much smarter and more interesting.

http://atomictorch.com/Images/Upload/10298.png?maxwidth=520

New content - A few new items have been added that you can purchase for your ship.

Stability improvements - And that is specifically the focus of this update. We've spent a lot of time polishing every bit of code to make sure that the game runs as smoothly as possible, but most importantly that there are not bugs on any systems (Windows, Mac and Linux) under any circumstances.

Possibilities for modding - As you requested on the forums - we've added a few new properties to data files and new API for scripting. So if that's your thing - make sure you see what's available for modding now!

http://atomictorch.com/Images/Upload/10296.png?maxwidth=520

...and a host of other new updates and changes! Make sure to let us know what you think about the update!

As always, you can read detailed patch notes on our forums.

notes.title: Updates v1.4.7 - 1.4.9 patch notes
notes.notes:
New features

    Skills reset - ask chief scientist about holodeck training!


Changes

    Friendly NPCs won't be so eager to attack you now if you accidentally hit them while fighting the bad guys
    Modding: added long trail XML values (see trail_engine_hull_shuttle.xml)
    Long mod descriptions will now be displayed truncated and button "read more" is added
    When you need a certain item for a quest the game will also check your station storage container if you're docked to the station
    Some pirates and Xengatarns will now try fly away if you critically damaged them
    NPC will try not to ram you so often :)


Fixes

    Fixed spawning of merchants, patrol, mining and headhunters ships
    Fixed ships getting stuck on station entry when loading a savegame where it was there
    Fixed damage being applied twice per hit, experience added twice per kill and other "twice" issue (including some quests problems!)
    Fixed local game server crash during Selek Jeredan's "Exodus" mission
    Fixed Exodus mission - civilian ship entering jumpgate effect
    Fixed (Steam version) mods configuration sometimes reset when you connect to a multiplayer server
    Fixed fanatics quest requiring luxuries while their supply is limited


! Notes !

 Saves are compatible with the previous singleplayer version
 For multiplayer - don't forget to update both: client AND server


Happy weekend!

notes.title: Update v1.4.6 is out!
notes.notes:
New features

    NPCs are now much smarter. They now understand that homing missiles can track enemies and will take that into account when deciding to make a shot (1)
    New API function npc.SetupWeaponUsage
    Galaxy generation cannot fail now - it will try generation with modified seed
    World seed info is now saved to savegame metadata (1)


Changes

    Ores and goods amount generation limited according to it's market value (1)
    Rebalanced trading profits within the same system (specifically faction capital systems)
    Trading experience now takes into account your character level
    Improved sort order for goods and ores in shop - they always will be displayed in a consistent order
    AI will not use weapons non-stop now
    NPC initial spawn improved (1)
    Improved balance with the starting and adjacent systems, difficulty specifically (1)
    SettingsServer.xml is now created right after server startup
    Path to SettingsServer.xml file is now printed to the server console


Fixes

    Fixed objects spawning too close or inside each other


Important! Points market with "(1)" require new game to have effect.

! Notes !

 Saves are compatible with the previous singleplayer version
 For multiplayer - don't forget to update both: client AND server


Happy weekend!

notes.title: Update v1.4.4 is out!
notes.notes:
=== VoidExpanse v1.4.4 ===

New features

    Now players ships has special icons for the System Map with a different icon for the party members
    Ships has colored name captions - easier to recognize the enemy and friendly ships


Changes

    Data and screenshots folders relocated on Linux and Mac (see below)
    /pwn command add also power cells (don't cheat please!)


Fixes

    Fixed some typos and errors in the text
    Resolved issue with launching the local and dedicated game server on Windows with FIPS-enforced security policy
    Fixed bug when while the chat opened the weapon aim lines stops updating
    Fixed NoesisGUI rare crash on Linux when using Alt+Tab


Notice for Linux & Mac users
Starting from v1.4.4 the game data will be stored in the proper system location (following standard Linux & Mac conventions):Linux: /AtomicTorchStudio --> ~/.config/AtomicTorchStudio
Maс: /AtomicTorchStudio --> ~/Library/Application Support/AtomicTorchStudio
(current data folder will transferred automatically when you start the new version first time)
The screenshots in the standalone version will be saved to the "/Pictures/VoidExpanse Screenshots" folder if it exists. Current screenshots will be also transferred automatically to this folder.

! Notes !

 Saves are compatible with the previous singleplayer version
 For multiplayer - don't forget to update both: client AND server


Happy weekend!

notes.title: VoidExpanse - v1.4 Update - Teaser
notes.notes:
It is finally time! Well, almost :)

We are putting some finishing touches on this update and will be ready to release the experimental version in a few days. And to make the wait a bit easier (or more difficult?) for you, here is a small teaser trailer that shows a couple of features that were added in this update.

YouTube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4aXxJEryxno

Some of the things that are shown in the video: new ships, new weapons, hacking system, new skills, new skill categories, new active devices, interactive space objects, longer trails for ships and projectiles, faction patrol system, etc.

This update is going to be big. Stay tuned for the release in a few days!

notes.title: Progress update
notes.notes:
It's been quite a silent time after we stabilized the game and removed most of the critical issues, or at least it might seem so. Now it's time to reveal (or remind, if you know it already) the reason of this silence - we are in the middle of development of a large content update. 

We have already finished some parts of the update, like new ships, weapons and items – all of that is fairly simple piece of work, actually. Most of the time when we finish a certain part of the update we post a news on our website, here: http://atomictorch.com/ All these things are naturally not accessible yet and they will be deployed with the rest of the content in one large update.

You can expect the final list of all new features and a detailed change log to be available together with the update. It will be posted both on our website and on Steam. 

Next week we are planning to finish and reveal some of the most important parts of the update including new mechanics. You'll be able to read about it on our website.

The bottom line is - if you want to be up to date on the things we have either completed or are working on you can always follow our blog http://atomictorch.com/

notes.title: Update v1.2.5 is out!
notes.notes:
This should be the final round of stability improvements for now. At least we are really hoping that it would be the case!

Either way, this update encompasses v1.2.3, v1.2.4 and v1.2.5.

So, for detailed patch notes please visit our forums
http://forums.atomictorch.com/index.php?topic=565.0

This update also includes a few new features, biggest of which is the omni-slots! Allowing you to equip different weapon types into the same hardpoint on your ship.

This update also addresses many issues with Mac and Linux! There are still a few thing we need to address here, but the work doesn't stop!

Happy weekend!

Thank you everyone who continues to help us improving the game!

notes.notes:

    Added TCP protocol for the Master Server connection, so the issues when the game is unable to connect with the Master Server should be fixed
    If VoidExpanse can't find server exe - it will report about ANTIVIRUS issue!
    Added protection from infinite loops in user scripts


Changes

    Added image validation to Mod uploader
    Escort quest temporary removed until we can make it better
    In auto-rotation mode the player's ship now rotates to fully match the cursor position
    Rebalanced asteroids and mining boosters

    Command "debug_topic_tutorial_complete player_name" in Multiplayer
    Chat command npcs_list
    Linux server CRASH
    Navpoint added by "Enter" click doesn't save it's name
    Various other issues, including crashes

notes.title: Update v1.2.1 is out!
notes.notes:
This new update is really important to improve stability and fix some important issues. We strongly recommend you to update ASAP.

This update also introduces a few minor improvements and new features to the game.

=== VoidExpanse v1.2.1 ===
New features:
   * Added ability to connect to servers running previous version of the game (if the server uses same network protocol version).
But you should still update ASAP! This version especially, as it addresses a lot of important issues!

Changes:
   * New balance for most weapons. Generally projectiles are more powerful.
   * Made chat more readable
   * Corrected descriptions of some things to make it more clear
   * Scurvy is now properly removed after quest is done (important for MP)
   * More signposting to make it easier to find certain things.
   * New repair price calculation. Now doesn't take ship price into account.
   * Other balancing changes.
   * New drop lists for all ships depending on their level!

Fixed:
   * "Save and quit" not working
   * Loading screen freezes. (we still need your feedback on this, please!)
   * Projectiles not rendered (OpenGL/Mac/Linux)
   * Local server crash on Mac
   * Quit game freezing
   * Fixed chat issues
   * Price of refuel from space merchants
   * Fixed Fanatics faction achievements
   * DirectX 9 / 11 issues
   * Game saving bug
   * Can't sell item ("can't find empty slot")
   * Several other server related issues

! Notes !
* Saves from previous version are compatible with this one.
* In case of multiplayer - don't forget to update both: client AND server.
* Please make sure if you are running a server that you update ASAP.

You can also read patch notes on our forum and join the discussion:
http://forums.atomictorch.com/index.php?topic=565.0

Thank you everyone who continues to help us improving the game!

As soon as the game is 100% stable for everyone we will go back to doing a large content update!
